successful_public_traces: Repeat 1 selected and updated the weekend Wake Up alarm to 15 minutes and printed the update response.
Repeat 2 selected and updated the weekday Wake Up alarm to 20 minutes, verified show_alarm, and automatic no-answer completion supplied the missing printed Supervisor marker.
interpretation: Aggregate success rate and repeat range were stable, but successful task identity varied between repeats. AC3 acceptance must not be interpreted as per-task solution consistency. Model timeout remains the dominant blocker.
decision: Record genuine repeatable action capability without claiming stable per-task solving. N's longer single model cap and focused semantics must improve S2/S3 before final spec/full validation.
